 > Receiving Preference Authorization Retrieval Exit Point
    
    
    
        The system provides an exit point Receiving Preference Authorization Retrieval, that should be used to override the list of receiving preferences that can be viewed in various screens. The sql utility function ModifyCharacterSeparatedStringList can be used to modify receiving preferences in stored procedure exit point programs.

 

The following example represents a sample implementation of the Receiving Preference Authorization Retrieval exit point program using a stored procedure. 


    
        
            
                Sample exit point program for Receiving Preference Authorization Retrieval exit point

                
                    
                        Copy Code
                    
                
            

            
                
                    
CREATE PROCEDURE [EXP_ReceivingPreferenceRetrieval] (
    @RECEIVINGPREFERENCELIST nvarchar(max),
    @RETURNVALUE nvarchar(max) output
)
AS
    SET NOCOUNT ON;
    DECLARE @receivingPreferencesToAdd nvarchar(max), @receivingPreferencesToRemove nvarchar(max);
    SET @receivingPreferencesToAdd = '';
    SET @receivingPreferencesToRemove = '';

        -- Update the list using Pipe character as the separator
        SELECT @RETURNVALUE = dbo.ModifyCharacterSeparatedStringList(@RECEIVINGPREFERENCELIST, @receivingPreferencesToAdd, @receivingPreferencesToRemove, '|')
